It should be this one, for two reasons that are about the citation and not about which lane got there first. I also confirmed, as the other refuter did, that the printed page itself cannot be opened from here: both archive.org scans, livingmountaince0000shep (Canongate 2011) and bwb_KR-674-517 (1984 Aberdeen), are lending-restricted and return Item not available on search-inside and a 302 on the OCR text. So the page rests on two independent readers of the named edition in both entries, and neither entry can claim more. Everything else about 04-phil-12 is sound and is preserved in 04-fict-16: Shepherd wrote in English so no translator is owed, the line is her own first-person prose with no speaker and no reporter trap, it is on none of the brief's misattribution rows, the work was first published in 1977 so it is in scope, Essay is the right tag, it is publishable, and shipped.js returns not shipped, nothing near, Shepherd 0 of 3, not banned.
